description: Flat legacy envelope with the five state channels at the top level.
contract: library/contract/output_formats.json — THE authority. This file is documentation; its mapping and descriptor are conformance-tested against the contract and are not read at run time.
instruction:
DEPRECATED since 3.1.0, removed in 4.0.0 — move to insight_v1.

IMPORTANT: You must return a valid JSON object.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
{
    "has_insight": boolean,
    "type": "suggestion" | "warning" | "opportunity" | "fact" | "praise",
    "content": "Your advice/insight here",
    "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
    "metadata": {},
    "events": [ {"name": "event_name", "payload": {"key": "value"}} ],
    "variable_updates": {"key": "value"},
    "queue_pushes": {"queue_name": [{"item": "data"}]},
    "facts": [ {"type": "fact_type", "key": "optional_key", "value": "extracted_value", "confidence": 0.9} ],
    "memory_updates": {"key": "value"}
}
